grok.pulse: NQ is gapping lower into the open (about -1.4% to -1.7% premarket) as NVDA (-3.5% to -4%) and AI infra extend losses a day before NVDA's print, with a new Commerce rule on China remote access to AI chips adding pressure; Brent -2% and BlackRock adding equity exposure are the only offsets.
grok.bias: risk-off — chips lead the selloff after Asia's semis rout (Taiex -6%, TSMC -5.7%), plus NVDA leadership uncertainty, a new China AI-chip access rule, falling crypto and Fed-hike pricing; softer oil is not enough to offset it
items: @Briefingcom (~9:16 AM ET): risk appetite fading as $NVDA and AI infra stocks extend declines; weak China data, falling crypto and expectations of more Fed tightening add pressure — Bearish NQ
@unusual_whales (~9:13 AM ET): Commerce Dept issues a rule stopping China from remotely accessing (renting) advanced US AI chips, closing the cloud loophole — Bearish NQ
@FirstSquawk (~9:22 AM ET): Brent -2% to $93.92 on recovering Middle East flows — Bullish NQ
@DeItaone (~9:14 AM ET): $BLK raises equity overweight to 3% from 1% across its $300B model portfolios and rebalances AI bets after the selloff — Bullish NQ
@DeItaone (~9:01 AM ET): Kremlin confirms a Trump-Putin-Xi three-way summit on Nov 19 at APEC — Mixed NQ
grok.trump: Truth Social (via @DeItaone, ~9:23 AM ET): claims US defenses neutralized nearly all Iranian drone and missile threats, saying Iran has launched 8,000-9,000 drones and ~2,000 ballistic missiles since Feb 28. He is flying to Asia with Lutnick and Bessent (~8:39 AM ET), and a Trump-Putin-Xi summit is set for Nov 19.

reports.pulse: Monday morning sees NQ futures down about 1% and ES softer as AI/tech sells off on Nvidia leadership uncertainty ahead of Tuesday earnings, amid fully priced December Fed hike bets and lingering Iran/oil risks near $95-96 Brent.
reports.bias: risk-off — Nasdaq/ES futures sliding on Nvidia/AI jitters and leadership vacuum, hot inflation supporting hawkish Dec hike (possible 50bp), oil elevated on Hormuz/Iran tensions; limited offsets from any short-covering or de-escalation hopes
items: @MarketJournalX (~7:00 AM ET): Nasdaq 100 futures erase gains and fall over -1% on the day as chip stocks sell off sharply; NVDA trading below $160 — Bearish NQ
@Get_Leveraged (~3:22 AM ET): Nasdaq futures down 1.0% as investors brace for Fed Chair Warsh speech today and Nvidia earnings tomorrow; QQQ short interest at 11% — Bearish NQ
@EssKayOne (~7:00 AM ET): Market Signal remains cautiously bullish but tech under pressure, Kospi down, expect choppy week with bearish tilt; key events retail sales, NVDA, ANT — Mixed NQ
@VuBuiNew (Sun ~6:09 PM ET): Market Pulse flags IRGC supertanker on Hormuz mine, Iran drones on Bahrain, Brent ~$95.84; hawkish Fed, Dec hike fully priced, 10Y 5.15%; NVDA Tue under Kress — Mixed NQ

@TradeloTrading (~4:59 AM ET): Iran claims drone strikes on US assets in Bahrain as USS Roosevelt arrives; Collins backs further Fed tightening; Bessent urges outside CEO search at Nvidia — Bearish NQ
reports.watch: Today: Fed Chair Warsh speech ~12 PM ET; Tue Nov 17: Oct retail sales 8:30 AM ET, HD/DIS BMO, NVDA AMC (first under interim CEO Kress); Wed: FOMC minutes 2 PM ET, Anthropic IPO pricing; Thu: ANT Nasdaq debut. Watch oil/Hormuz, 10Y ~5.15%, AI/semis reaction.

reports.pulse: NQ is gapping lower in premarket (about -1.6% to -1.7%, at session lows) as NVDA slides 4-5% on the Huang leadership fight ahead of Tuesday's print and Asia semis got routed overnight; softer oil on the IEA surplus revision is the only real offset.
reports.bias: risk-off — NVDA/AI-semis selloff (Taiwan -7% overnight, NVDA ~-$2T since the Oct 6 peak) plus hike-risk talk (Deutsche Bank) outweigh lower Brent (~$95) and Trump's 'National Champion' nod for NVDA
items: @DeItaone (~7:22 AM ET): ES -0.75%, NQ -1.56%, YM -0.13%; @FirstSquawk (~7:31 AM ET) says ES/NQ extending to session lows — Bearish NQ

@KobeissiLetter (~7:32 AM ET): NQ -1.7% premarket as NVDA falls >5%; NVDA has erased ~$2T of market cap since its Oct 6 peak. Lynx (via @DeItaone ~7:17 AM) sees almost no chance Huang returns — Bearish NQ
X News (~5:05 AM ET): Japan Q3 GDP -0.1% annualized (missed); Taiwan -7%, Nikkei -2.4%, so Asia chip names dumped overnight — Bearish NQ
X News (~7:33 AM ET): Brent $95.37, WTI $88.33, lower after the IEA sees a 1.7M bpd Q4 surplus as Hormuz flows recover; IRGC (~7:14 AM) claims US-escorted tankers hit mines in Hormuz — Mixed NQ
@WatcherGuru (Sun ~11:07 PM ET): Trump to designate $NVDA an AI "National Champion"; Bessent reportedly opposes Huang's return (@DeItaone ~7:12 AM) — Mixed NQ
reports.trump: Per @WatcherGuru (Sun ~11:07 PM ET), Trump plans to designate Nvidia an AI "National Champion". Treasury Sec. Bessent reportedly opposes Jensen Huang's return as CEO (@DeItaone ~7:12 AM ET). Israel Hayom reports an alleged Iranian drone plot against Trump, which has tightened his security.
